meta.name: tdd-generator
meta.description: Generate a Technical Design Document (TDD) or lightweight Tech Spec for a feature. Supports LIGHT mode (~3-page spec for simple changes) and HEAVY mode (full architecture document for complex features). Use when the user needs technical implementation specs, architecture decisions for a feature, or a developer-facing design document. Triggers on requests like "create a TDD", "write a tech spec", "technical design for this feature", or "architecture document".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成技术设计文档,让开发有据可依
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要为功能编写技术设计文档或架构说明且希望快速产出
copy.tagline_en: Generate technical design documents to guide feature development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce a technical design document or architecture spec for a feature quickly

howto.what: 安装此技能后,Claude 会根据你描述的功能,自动生成一份技术设计文档。文档只写新增或改动的部分,尽量用图表展示流程,并区分简单版(约3页)和完整版两种规格。
howto.when: 当你说出“create a TDD”“write a tech spec”等关键词,或需要功能的技术实现规格时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个新功能写一份 TDD。
say.note: Claude 会先确认用轻量还是完整模式。

say.text: 我只改了登录流程,请生成轻量版技术规格。
say.note: 直接进入 LIGHT 模式,约3页。

say.text: 这个功能要对接外部系统,给我一份完整架构文档。
say.note: 触发 HEAVY 模式,生成完整模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a technical design document based on the feature you describe. It focuses only on new or changed parts, uses Mermaid diagrams where possible, and supports a light (~3 pages) or full architecture mode.
howto.when_en: Triggered by 'create a TDD', 'write a tech spec', or similar requests for technical implementation specs.

say_en.text: Please write a TDD for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm LIGHT or HEAVY mode first.

say_en.text: I only changed the login flow; generate a light tech spec.
say_en.note: Goes straight to LIGHT mode, ~3 pages.

say_en.text: This feature integrates an external system; provide a full architecture doc.
say_en.note: Triggers HEAVY mode with the full template.
